note: completionRate = fraction of sampled players who have finished this task. Lower means rarer, and rarer is treated as harder.
sampleBias: Players are discovered through the auction house (current listings + recent trades), which is the only UUID-discovery path the public HTTP API offers. That selects for players active in the economy and skews the whole sample toward more advanced accounts. Rates are relative difficulty within that population, not an absolute rate across everyone who has ever played.

calibration.method: Our sampled players' SkyBlock level distribution, compared against a published external reference collected by a different method (see citation).
calibration.citation: tla_, "Data #1: Distribution of SkyBlock Levels", Hypixel Forums, 19 Jan 2024 — https://hypixel.net/threads/data-1-distribution-of-skyblock-levels.5579975/ — ~9,800 UUIDs logged by AFKing in the SkyBlock login lobby, which the author describes as catching "basically every skyblock main" who logged in during that window.

skew.interpretation: our sample skews toward more advanced accounts than the login-lobby reference — expected, since the auction house selects for economically active players
